answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Gown maker velvet waistcoat mark sewn into the needle case, spelled out in full as each velvet waistcoat is a fitting record witnessed by the inspector. A farm can rehearse the quill and rehearse the ivory, but it cannot rehearse the dune, because a year will not rehearse. An honest proof costs 207 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 549 of them, which totals 113643 POA. The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
